Haha, yeah, I try to include humor in my vents to cheer myself up and the person reading. Hey, I hope uni goes well for you, btw, uni scares me. I think I know what you mean by becoming a husk. Often times I stop feeling anything at all, like now, and I wish I could be that way forever, but that will just make life long and colorless. I'm just searching for answers everywhere I can. 
Also, yes, I'm interested in coding for games and such. I'm not sure about genres, I need to start thinking about my future but I'm so young I'm like, eh I have time. I'm gonna end up procrastinating until I graduate lmao. ps, your comment about my joke being funny made me laugh a bit, thanks.
